requirementSummary: 项目「GIS 任务管理平台」；领域：GIS / 地理信息；核心能力：地图渲染与图层管理、空间查询与分析、影像/栅格处理、任务/工单流程、认证与权限；约束：需要可上线部署、使用真实数据、需要认证与权限、production-ready web application；建议方案：Build a Docker-deployable web GIS platform for urban facility inspection teams, combining an interactive map with layer toggles, facility point CRUD and filtering, spatial queries by location or bounding box, inspection work orders with assignment and status workflow plus overdue flags, image uploads tied to facilities, and role-based login for admins and inspectors, backed by a real spatial database and real map tiles.
capabilities: map overview with base map, facility point and inspection route layer toggling
facility point CRUD with type and status filtering
spatial query by current location or bounding box selection
inspection work order creation, assignment, status transitions and overdue marking
